Moderated questions

The 2027 questions that decide whether AI becomes an operating capability.

Each question is designed to turn the prior sessions into leadership commitments, not more exploratory discussion.

01

Who should own AI in 2027?

Should ownership sit with a central AI office, business units, technology, operations, strategy, risk, or a shared executive council?

02

What decisions need a repeatable cadence?

Which funding, risk, vendor, workforce, and portfolio decisions should happen monthly, quarterly, or at the board level?

03

What should be centralized versus federated?

Which capabilities belong in a shared platform or center of excellence, and which belong close to the business workflow?

04

How does the talent model need to change?

What new skills, roles, training, incentives, and management expectations are required for AI-enabled work?

05

What should the 2027 AI portfolio contain?

How should leaders balance productivity, revenue, workflow automation, data foundation, security, governance, and strategic bets?

06

Which partners matter most next year?

Where do organizations need technology vendors, advisory partners, implementation support, research access, or peer networks?

07

How will leadership know the model is working?

What metrics, dashboards, reviews, stories, and executive conversations should show whether AI is becoming a real capability?

08

What should the 2027 summit agenda force us to answer?

Which unresolved questions should become MOJO AI Summits tracks, brief topics, speaker invitations, or member working groups?
